subject: POC Kickoff + Hands-on Sprint: calendar, roles, and load plan
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@quantacorp.com>, ops@quantacorp.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro — POC kickoff planning

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the overview on the call earlier. Quanta is excited to move forward with a short hands-on POC to validate routing/latency and prompt fidelity at scale. A couple of asks from our side before we lock dates: 

- Can you share a short success criteria doc so we can align with stakeholders (security, infra, ML eng)?
- We have a hard blackout for load tests between 7/19–7/23 due to a planned release — can we avoid that window?
- Preferred timezone for our ops folks is EST, Samir is in London but can flex.

I've attached a quick one-pager with our internal goals. Happy to take a 20–30m kickoff to meet stakeholders.

Best,
Elena
Sr. Product Manager, QuantaCorp
attachments: Quanta-POC-onepager.pdf (pdf)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantacorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@quantacorp.com>, ops@quantacorp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — POC kickoff planning

Elena — thanks for the details and the one-pager. Quick replies inline plus next steps: 

- Success criteria: attached is a draft (POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf) with three measurable goals (prompt fidelity, 95th pct latency under 450ms for 256 tokens, and routing accuracy for region/cost policy). Please flag additions.
- Scheduling: noted your blackout 7/19–7/23 — that works. Proposed kickoff windows: 7/26 10:00–10:45am ET or 7/27 11:00–11:45am ET. For hands-on load trials we recommend a two-day working sprint during 7/29–7/30 (low-impact times) — we will provide a load-plan template.
- Attendees: can you confirm who from security and infra should join the kickoff? We want to cover network/VPN, certificate expectations, and audit log needs.

Action items: 
- Elena: confirm kickoff attendees and preferred kickoff date (reply)
- Quanta ops: confirm whether any additional IP allowlist steps are needed for the dedicated pool
- Redwood: we (Marissa/Sergio) will circulate the load plan and a 30-minute prompt review session deck.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf, load-plan-template.xlsx
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@quantacorp.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantacorp.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 16:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Intro — POC kickoff planning

Karthik / Elena — quick note from infra: we can attend the kickoff but for the hands-on load tests we'd prefer the 7/29–7/30 window in the evening EST (US business off-hours) to limit impact on our throughput. Can Redwood support a late-evening two-day slot for the load run? Also we need an IP list and certificate thumbprint before the session.

Samir
Infra Lead, QuantaCorp
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantacorp.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, ops@quantacorp.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — POC kickoff planning

Elena / Samir — thanks. We can absolutely run the load trials 7/29–7/30 during evening EST windows. Proposed schedule: 

Day 1 (7/29) — 18:00–22:00 ET
- 18:00–18:30: prompt review & routing sanity check (identify prompt sets, test branching rules)
- 18:30–21:30: incremental load ramp (steady-state targets + spike tests)
- 21:30–22:00: debrief and quick data snapshot

Day 2 (7/30) — 18:00–21:00 ET
- 18:00–18:30: review regressions and prompt tuning
- 18:30–20:30: targeted routing/cost policy validation (canary fallback test)
- 20:30–21:00: final acceptance check and handover checklist

We will lead the prompt review; Karthik will own routing checks; Sergio will run the load harness and capture latency percentiles. Attached is a fillable load-plan-template.xlsx — please populate expected QPS, sample prompt sets, and acceptance thresholds by 7/23 so we can finalize capacity.

Marissa
Eng PM, Redwood Inference
attachments: load-plan-template.xlsx
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@quantacorp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@quantacorp.com>, ops@quantacorp.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro — POC kickoff planning

Thanks everyone — confirms: kickoff meeting on 7/26 at 10:00 ET (we accepted the calendar invite) and load-run windows 7/29–7/30 evenings ET as proposed.

Quick notes: 
- Security will join kickoff as "Ana Chen (security)" and "Marcus Lin (network)" — CC'ing offline so they get the invites.
- We completed the load-plan draft and uploaded it to the HubSpot deal notes (link: https://hubspot.com/deal/QC-2027-0894). Please review the QPS numbers and sample prompts; we'll add the IP allowlist by EOD 7/23.
- One small ask: can Redwood run the prompt fidelity checklist (5 canonical prompts) during the prompt review and capture both generation score and token breakdown? That metric is important for our PMs.

Elena
Sr. Product Manager, QuantaCorp
attachments: none
